# Fixture Provenance

Fixtures under `tests/backend/fixtures/` derived from USNO material identify
their public reference and expected calculation scope in their JSON content
and corresponding tests.

Other chart fixtures are synthetic engineering inputs. In particular, the
tuple `1997-08-17 09:42`, `Asia/Taipei`, `24.1477/120.6736` was generated
during development and has no known link to an identified person. Its original
generation procedure is unknown, so it must not be described as random,
anonymized real data, or impossible to coincide with an unknown person's birth
details.

Do not add real user or contributor birth data to this repository.
